messages:
Anika (Marketing): Quick ask — can runtime team run a focused data collection for the Q2 launch post + webinar? Need numbers we can cite: p50/p95/p99 latencies, cost per 1k tokens, and embedding throughput for a short blurb and one deep-dive slide. Prefer results we can reproduce.

Anika (Marketing): Scope: hosted API + dedicated. Models: redwood-v3-small, redwood-v3-large, and a quantized candidate for large. Also embeddings workload (typical 1536-dim).

Tom (Eng Runtime): On it. A couple clarifying points: 1) live-demo numbers = short chat (avg 40 tokens), 2) deep-dive wants long-run numbers? if so what length? 3) dedicated hardware preference?

Anika (Marketing): Live demo = short (40 tokens). Deep-dive = 1 sample at 3k tokens + one long context at ~6k for the slide. Dedicated: H100 preferred but fall back to A10G. Also include cold vs warm cache notes.

Tom (Eng Runtime): Plan: hosted smoke (100 prompts, concurrency 1 & 16), dedicated H100 run (short + long), quantized short-run (measure throughput delta). Add embedding test: 2k vectors, batch sizes 1/64/256, measure vector/s and p99. We'll produce CSVs, a short TSV summary, and one slide.

Tom (Eng Runtime): For cost estimates, do you want retail API price or internal per-GPU cost? Marketing typically uses retail numbers.

Anika (Marketing): Retail-ish, but also add an internal-cost footnote for enterprise pitch. Keep messaging simple for public: per-1k-token cost and p95 latency.

Priya (SRE): Heads-up: Dedicated H100 pool has a maintenance window tonight 23:00 UTC. If you need guaranteed H100 runs tomorrow morning, we should reserve capacity. I can reserve a slot.

Anika (Marketing): Please reserve if it's quick — we can't risk a flaky run for the press slide.

Priya (SRE): Reserved runner h100-marketing-1 for morning slot.

Liam (DevEx): Use bench-runner template: go/redwood/bench-runbook, tag runs as marketing-q2-webinar. Please attach the exact command, docker image, and git sha to the job notes for reproducibility. Also capture system traces if any p99 > 1s.

Tom (Eng Runtime): Noted. I'll run with deterministic sampling (seeded) for the long-context samples so text variability doesn't skew latency. We'll also capture token emission times and server-side queue time.

Tom (Eng Runtime): Suggested hosted payload snippet:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v3-large","input":"Explain in one sentence why low latency matters for productized LLM features","max_tokens":60,"stream":false}'
```

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-runner/marketing-q2-webinar on runner-h100-marketing-1. Job id: br-91077. ETA: ~2h.

Tom (Eng Runtime): If we see >15% improvement from quantization without huge quality loss, we'll flag that in the slide as an optimization option. Also we'll include a short note on measurement variance and repeatability.

Anika (Marketing): Great. Deliverables: raw CSVs, a consolidated CSV with computed p50/p95/p99 and cost-per-1k, and a single slide (png) with 3 bullets and a tiny callout box for cache/capacity caveats. Deadline: EOD Friday.

Priya (SRE): If any job hits infra limits I'll post here and we can escalate to capacity owners.

Tom (Eng Runtime): Starting the hosted smoke now, will post preliminary CSV in ~40m. Then I'll run the H100 suite after.

Anika (Marketing): Awesome — ping here when the PNG is ready. Thanks team :rocket:
